retrospective_one_threshold_all_future_c.reason: At least one later collection cannot meet the genuine goal even without a distance gate

methods.registry: Source collection runs 0..7, UUID aligned, minimum L1 distance; ties rejected
methods.calibration: Source collection run 9 only; fixed p90/p95/p99 applied to every destination
methods.genuine: Destination collection run 8, uniform seeds only
methods.source_trained: Correction from source registration means over all other uniform seeds; no destination target responses used
methods.destination_trained: Correction refreshed using destination registration means over other uniform seeds; optimistic access to target training data under destination conditions
methods.decoys: Destination run 8; fixed single (target+1)%G or median ensemble of all G-1 other GPUs
methods.response: Explicit truncation toward zero before exact integer L1; lambdas 1,1.5,2
methods.sweep: All observed eligible-score breakpoints; retrospective, not independent threshold validation

limits: Finite observed challenges and specified attack models only; cannot prove security or universal impossibility.
Rates share seeds, chips and training data; no independent-trial confidence claims.
Source-trained corrections exclude the challenge seed; actual verifier registry reuse for training seeds is an evaluation assumption.
Destination-trained mode is not proof that an attacker can obtain same-condition target training data chronologically before each challenge.
Four collections on same eight H200s over about thirteen minutes; no established power-cycle/transport intervention.
No attack latency, network relay, or replay-table study is performed here.
